children: American Drive reported net income in the quarter, compared with a net loss in the prior-year period. Interest earned on trust-account marketable securities was $2.1M, offset by $229,133 in general and administrative fees; it has not begun operations or generated revenue.
: The company is identifying a target and intends to complete a business combination within its 24-month completion window, ending December 19, 2027.
: Marketable securities in the trust account totaled $236.5M at September 30, 2026, invested in money market funds holding U.S. Treasury securities.
: Cash was $696,517 and the company had a $660,310 working capital deficit at September 30, 2026.
: Management said the company lacks liquidity to sustain operations for at least one year and that this raises substantial doubt about its ability to continue as a going concern.
